services.name: intake-coach
services.description: Evaluates incoming Feature Requests against quality criteria and produces an FRQ score with actionable improvement suggestions.

services.name: prioritization-copilot
services.description: Calculates SAS (Strategic Alignment Score) and RCS (Risk & Complexity Score), identifies overlap with other initiatives, recommends risk band.

services.name: brief-builder
services.description: Structures the Feature Brief Pack from FRQ, research inputs, and interview notes. Generates hypothesis, ACs, in/out of scope.

services.name: research-synthesizer
services.description: Synthesizes qualitative research (interviews, support tickets, usage data) into structured insights. Works alongside brief-builder in the Discovery phase.

services.name: design-critic
services.description: Reviews design specs against ACs and UX principles. Flags inconsistencies between user flows, edge cases missing in wireframes, and AC coverage gaps.

services.name: solution-mapper
services.description: Produces the Technical Design Note skeleton: system boundaries, data flow, integration points, risk flags, and dependency map.

services.name: code-review-agent
services.description: Reviews PRs for AC traceability, test coverage, security patterns, and adherence to the Technical Design Note. Does not replace human code review.

services.name: test-case-generator
services.description: Derives test cases from ACs, edge cases, and technical design. Produces structured test plans covering happy paths, error paths, and boundary conditions.

services.name: release-verifier
services.description: Checks release checklist completeness, verifies all ACs are covered, flags missing rollback documentation and monitoring setup.

services.name: dashboard-narrator
services.description: Reads post-release telemetry and produces the Impact Review draft: KPI deltas, adoption trends, anomaly flags, and next-action suggestions.

services.name: dependency-mapper
services.description: Maps cross-team and cross-system dependencies for Scale mode initiatives. Produces a structured dependency matrix with risk assessment per dependency.

services.name: compliance-checker
services.description: Verifies that artifacts and decisions comply with declared regulatory constraints (GDPR, SOC2, electronic invoicing regulations). Used primarily in Scale mode.

services.name: consistency-checker
services.description: Adversarial cross-artifact check at gates. Surfaces contradictions, dropped constraints, KPI coverage gaps, hypothesis gaps, and mode drift across the artifact chain.

retention_policy_definitions.session-only: Output not stored after session ends. No data persists.
retention_policy_definitions.sprint: Output retained for the duration of the current sprint (max 2 weeks).
retention_policy_definitions.release-cycle: Output retained until the release is closed and Impact Review is produced.
retention_policy_definitions.90-days: Output retained for 90 days post-release for learning loop purposes.
retention_policy_definitions.audit-trail: Output retained indefinitely as part of compliance audit trail.

output_visibility_definitions.internal-team: Visible only to product team members on the initiative.
output_visibility_definitions.compliance-team: Visible to product team and compliance/legal function.

autonomy_tier_definitions.HITL: Human-in-the-loop. Every output must be reviewed by a named human before incorporation. Required for high-PII, judgment-structuring, and gate-driving services.
autonomy_tier_definitions.HOTL: Human-on-the-loop. Parameters and guardrails set up front; outputs reviewed by sample (e.g. 10% audit) and on exception. Suitable for high-volume, low-risk, low-stakes structuring tasks.
autonomy_tier_definitions.HOOTL: Human-out-of-the-loop. Autonomous within strict guardrails; ex-post audit only. Reserved for low-risk, fully-reversible tasks. No service in v1.4 uses this tier.

ai_act_risk_definitions.limited: EU AI Act limited-risk system: transparency obligations apply. Default for assistive AI in product workflows.
ai_act_risk_definitions.high: EU AI Act high-risk system: full Article 14 oversight, conformity assessment, post-market monitoring required. Currently applies to compliance-checker only.
ai_act_risk_definitions.minimal: EU AI Act minimal-risk: no obligations. Not used for ORDITO services.
